description: This file defines the LeaveBalanceAPI class, which serves as a REST API endpoint for retrieving leave balance information within an HR management system. It includes methods for fetching leave balances for specific leave types and date ranges, normalizing data, and handling leave period breakdowns.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceAPI
classes.description: A REST API endpoint class for fetching leave balance details for employees, including balance breakdown, entitlement, and leave periods, within the OrangeHRM human resource management system.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve leave balance information for a specific leave type and optional date range, returning normalized data along with related employee and leave type details.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for parameters when fetching a leave balance, including employee number and date range validation.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getLeaveTypeAsArray
methods.description: Fetches and normalizes leave type data into an array for use in API responses.

methods.name: getNormalizedLeaveBalanceResult
methods.description: Processes leave period data to compute and normalize leave balances, detecting negative balances and generating detailed breakdowns.

methods.name: getLeaveBreakdownForAppliedDateRange
methods.description: Creates a breakdown of leave days over a date range, grouping them into leave periods and noting holiday or weekend statuses.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieves the leave entitlement period for a specific date, employee, and leave type.
